description: Scale-1 golden corpus indexed by the TS CLI (obelisk v0.2.3). Counts are read from expected-dump.json (indexed truth), not from the generator.
coverage: claude: ai-title + history.jsonl titles, meta <command-name> envelope, skill_instructions meta, thinking/text/tool_use blocks (Read/Skill/Edit/Task/Workflow), tool_result with is_error + toolUseResult.filePath, away_summary, turn_duration, usage with cache tokens, gitBranch/version/cwd, plain subagent (.jsonl + .meta.json), workflow run json + workflowProgress agents + workflow-linked agent transcript (subagents/workflows/<runId>/agent-11.jsonl)

codex: session_meta, turn_context model, event_msg user/agent messages, response_item duplicate dedup, custom_tool_call(+output), function_call(+output), token_count, task_complete durations, collab_agent_spawn_end subagent spawn, thread_name_updated + session_index.jsonl titles, hidden <environment_context> user message, child subagent thread (thread_spawn parent)

deepseek: session.jsonl.zstd multi-frame checksummed zstd artifact, request/header model, user/assistant messages (reasoning/text/tool-call parts), tool/call + tool/result (incl. data.error), subagent spawn result link, session/title, root+child tree grouped as one unit

kimi: state.json + agents/main/wire.jsonl + agents/agent-7/wire.jsonl, config.update model, step.begin/content.part/tool.call/tool.result/step.end with usage, context.undo + context.clear replay, legacy protocol-1.0 embedded toolCalls, context.apply_compaction summary, subagent link via agent_id: result text

pi: session v3 headers, user/assistant/toolResult messages with usage + cost, toolCall blocks, inactive branch + branch_summary, legacy compaction (firstKeptEntryId), checkpoint compaction with retainedTail, leaf heads, orphan chain with missing parent, session_info titles
